name: @codegraph/desktop
description: The Codegraph desktop app: a Tauri 2 shell over the codegraph daemon (PLAN.md §15.4). Not built by `pnpm -r build` — the shell needs a Rust toolchain and the platform's WebKit; `pnpm tauri:dev` / `pnpm tauri:build` are explicit.

scripts.build: echo 'desktop: not part of pnpm -r build — use pnpm --filter @codegraph/desktop tauri:build' >&2
